question: On 7 March 2022, the Ministry of Women and Child Development (MoWCD), in partnership with the Ministry of Education and UNICEF, launched the ______ campaign to bring back out of school adolescent girls in India to the formal education.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kanya Shikhsa Pravesh Utsav**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Kanya Shikhsa Pravesh Utsav** is a nationwide campaign launched to bring back out-of-school adolescent girls in India to the formal education system.
 
• The campaign was launched on **7 March 2022** by the Ministry of Women and Child Development (MoWCD) in partnership with the Ministry of Education and UNICEF.
 
• The initiative primarily focuses on ensuring access to education for girls aged **11 to 14 years**, who have dropped out of schools.
 
• It aligns with the government’s vision of universal education under the **National Education Policy (NEP) 2020**.
 
• The campaign also seeks to address barriers to girls' education, such as social norms, economic challenges, and lack of access to schools.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **National Education Policy (NEP) 2020:**

 
 
• Aims to ensure equitable access to education for all, with special focus on marginalized groups.
 
• Targets universalization of school education from preschool to secondary level by 2030.
 
• Emphasizes inclusive and quality education to address gender disparity in education.
 
 
 
• **UNICEF's Role:**
 
 
• UNICEF has been collaborating with the Indian government to promote education and child welfare.
 
• It provides technical support and expertise for initiatives like **Kanya Shikhsa Pravesh Utsav**.
 
 
 
• **Barriers to Girls' Education:**
 
 
• Factors include poverty, early marriage, gender bias, and inadequate infrastructure like lack of separate toilets for girls.
 
• Programs like this aim to reduce dropout rates and improve enrollment figures for adolescent girls.
 
 
 
• **Schemes Complementing the Campaign:**
 
 
• **Beti Bachao Beti Padhao:** Focuses on the survival, protection, and education of the girl child.
 
• **Samagra Shiksha Abhiyan:** An integrated scheme for school education covering pre-school to senior secondary levels.
